_note: The exactness anchor: an all-ls outcome node IS an ordered-logit model, so the flow's MLE must equal statsmodels. Multi-phase Adam at restore_best=False reaches it to ~4e-4.

max_abs_diff_flow_vs_statsmodels.why: a floor, not a multiple: this Adam fit agrees to 4.3e-04, far below the 1e-3 that any comparison in this repo claims, and nothing has measured its cross-machine spread. Tightening to 2.5x a 1e-5 measurement would fail on another machine for no reason
